title: ux
description: What UX components keep and say, in a page's own graph: never synced.

Edit.description: a value being changed where it stands (@yaks/ux Edit), on an entity of its own whose eid is derived from its owner and the value: open while it is, what is typed over it, and what its picker searches for

open.description: being changed: typed over in place, or its picker floating beside it

text.description: what is typed over the value so far; a remount types on from it

query.description: what is typed in its picker's search

Refused.description: an event an Edit emits on the entity whose value it changes: what was typed could not be read as the value's type
